narrative.details:
Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study.  Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young champion.  And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!

But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.

There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave.  Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.
narrative.objectives: Bring a Webwood Egg to Gilshalan in Aldrassil.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, very good. I will have this egg and the venom transported to Darnassus, then return there when my studies are done here. I expect to find out a great deal from these specimens, adventurer. You have been a great help to me.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, adventurer? Did you find a spider egg?
